caption: The drawing depicts a sculpture of a standing human figure with medium brown skin, positioned on a rectangular, wood-like pedestal or base that is shaded in brown and grey tones. The figure is wearing a knee-length reddish-brown tunic adorned with gold-colored trim along the edges, as well as matching reddish-brown leggings and shoes. The right hand of the figure is placed across the chest while the left hand rests by the side. The figure has long dark brown or black hair and wears a large yellow or gold-colored headdress adorned with upright, multicolored feathers—primarily red and green with some dark accents. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned.
title: Cigar Store Indian
